text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, some API requests failed. During this period, 12% of the requests failed with the HTTP 502 error. A new deploy caused the problem. The deploy removed the cache warmup step. Because of this change, the servers could not answer some requests correctly. The engineers found the cause quickly. They reverted the deploy at 14:27 UTC. After the revert, the cache became warm again. The error rate then returned to normal. All API requests now work correctly. We are sorry for this interruption. We will add a test that prevents this problem in the future.
